lines: Through honeyed lips that steal the mind — through watcher and the watched,
triumphs the Lord whose power is joy paraded: God on high.
sanskrit_cite: sugirā cittahāriṇyā paśyantyā dṛśyamānayā jayaty ullāsitānandamahimā parameśvaraḥ
notes: first L4 verse of the work — owner verdict requested before continuing (rules 15/17)
